_note: v11.4: v11.1 (pair + crop + disease condition) on v10.3's LoRA image features. Single change from v11.1; same features as v11.3 (cached, so it costs minutes after v11.3).
_result: Not kept against v10.3 (+0.7 val < 2), though the best validation HM of any single model so far and higher than v10.3 on 2 of 3 splits. Mean validation HM 61.85% (classifier epoch 2, gamma 0.0425; per split 59.64 / 62.57 / 63.35) vs v10.3 61.15% and v11.3 60.24% (+1.6 over v11.3, as on frozen features: the compositional condition helps consistently but each time below the 2-point rule). Test (reported, not used to decide): HM 66.1% (seen 62.1%, unseen 70.8%) vs v10.3 66.3% (55.1 / 83.3): same HM with a very different seen/unseen balance, so a candidate ensemble member.
title: lora_compositional

model._note: Frozen OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/16 (QuickGELU), as v3/v4.2; image embeddings come from the runs/cache embedding cache.

features._note: Image features from v10.3's LoRA-adapted CLIP encoder instead of the frozen CLIP. Test features: v10.3's saved adapters (its final model, trained on all train). Validation: v10.3 is retrained on each split's fit images (same seed per split, its selected 8 epochs) so the pseudo-unseen pairs are unseen by the encoder too; features cached in runs/cache/lora_features/. Caveat: training images were seen by the encoder, so their features are tighter than test features (the same holds in validation, so selection accounts for it).

prompts._note: v3's knowledge-base templates for the pair text (the frozen text encoder's embedding of these is the generator condition and the classifier's initial weights). crop_templates / disease_templates are only used when condition.parts includes 'crop' / 'disease'.
templates: a close-up photo of a {crop} leaf showing {disease}: {description}.
a field photo of {crop} leaves with {disease}: {description}.
healthy_templates: a close-up photo of a healthy {crop} leaf: {description}.
a field photo of healthy {crop} leaves: {description}.
crop_templates: a close-up photo of a {crop} leaf.
disease_templates: a close-up photo of a leaf showing {disease}: {description}.

condition._note: pair + crop + disease prompt embeddings, concatenated.

aux_classifier._note: Cosine classifier on the real features of the trained pairs; frozen, it gives the GAN's classification loss (keeps generated features recognisable).

gan._note: f-CLSWGAN defaults (one 4096-unit hidden layer each, LeakyReLU 0.2, Adam 1e-4 / beta1 0.5, 5 critic steps per generator step, GP 10, cls weight 0.01). Output L2-normalised like the real CLIP embeddings.

synthesis._note: Synthetic features per untrained target pair (300 as in f-CLSWGAN). seen_min_per_pair > 0 would also top up rare seen pairs to that many features.

classifier._note: Final cosine classifier over all pairs, initialised from the pair text embeddings; epoch chosen on validation. Saved scores are logits / 100 (CLIP's cosine scale).

validation._note: Same three splits as v5.8/v10.3 (seeds 42-44; 20 pseudo-unseen pairs each). In validation the GAN is trained on the fit images only and generates the 20 pseudo-unseen pairs; the 10 real unseen pairs are hidden (not generated, not scored). gamma_grid includes negative values because, unlike the prompt models, a classifier trained on many synthetic unseen features can over-predict unseen pairs.
